Extended K-Shell Hybrid Method

Source: R/centrality-batch66.R
centrality_eskh.Rd

The extended k-shell hybrid method (Namtirtha et al. 2018, who write it \(ks_{h+}\)) sums the k-shell hybrid score of the neighbors of a node: $$ESKH(m) = \sum_{j \in N(m)} ksh(j),$$ with \(ksh\) the score centrality_ksh returns.

Usage

centrality_eskh(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality. The measure uses ksh_mu (the weight of the neighbor's degree, default 0.4) and ksh_radius (the largest distance summed over, default 3).

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order.

Details

The measure is computed on the simple undirected skeleton of the network, so direction, weights, loops and parallel edges are ignored. The node's own score is not added: the source's worked example and the values it prints for its leaves require the open neighborhood. ksh_mu and ksh_radius are those of centrality_ksh. With the defaults the implementation reproduces the 13 values Maji et al. (2020) print for the 13-node example and 11 of the 14 values of the source. The other three are one quantity, which the source obtains by adding values already truncated to two decimals (48.03, where the exact value is 48.045). Isolated nodes score 0. A ksh_mu outside \([0, 1]\), or a ksh_radius that is not a whole number of at least one or Inf, raises a cograph_bad_parameter error. normalized = TRUE divides the scores by their maximum.

References

Namtirtha, A., Dutta, A. and Dutta, B. (2018). Identifying influential spreaders in complex networks based on kshell hybrid method. Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, 499, 310-324. doi:10.1016/j.physa.2018.02.016 .

Maji, G., Namtirtha, A., Dutta, A. and Curado Malta, M. (2020). Influential spreaders identification in complex networks with improved k-shell hybrid method. Expert Systems with Applications, 144, 113092. doi:10.1016/j.eswa.2019.113092 .

See also

centrality_ksh, centrality_eikh, centrality.

Examples

centrality_eskh(regulation_net)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>   157.7955   189.8660   218.9366   186.0447   155.1741   160.1168   133.3675 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>   167.1594   192.4873   167.4594
